fields.label: Shot frame
fields.description: The source-defined amount of the applicant visible in the image; source labels remain on each rule.

allowedValues.label: Full length
allowedValues.description: A head-to-toe or source-labelled full-length frame.

allowedValues.label: Portrait length
allowedValues.description: The distinct portrait-length frame named by a source; it is not automatically equivalent to a headshot.

allowedValues.label: Close-up
allowedValues.description: A tightly framed face or head-and-shoulders image.

allowedValues.label: Headshot
allowedValues.description: A source-labelled headshot without assuming a tighter close-up framing.

allowedValues.label: Mid-length
allowedValues.description: A source-labelled mid-length frame without inferring an exact crop boundary.

allowedValues.label: Waist-up
allowedValues.description: A frame showing the applicant from approximately the waist upward.

allowedValues.label: Three-quarter length
allowedValues.description: A source-labelled 3/4-length frame, between a waist-up crop and a full-length one; the exact crop boundary is not inferred.

fields.label: Shot view
fields.description: The applicant's orientation relative to the camera.

allowedValues.label: Front
allowedValues.description: The applicant faces the camera.

allowedValues.label: Profile
allowedValues.description: A side profile; left and right are compatible subtypes.

fields.label: Shot purpose
fields.description: A source-defined communicative purpose that cannot always be reduced to framing or pose.

allowedValues.label: Personality
allowedValues.description: An image intended to communicate personality; manual confirmation is required in v1.

fields.label: Hair state
fields.description: How hair is positioned for a shot.

allowedValues.label: Pulled back
allowedValues.description: Hair is pulled back from the face.

allowedValues.label: Away from face
allowedValues.description: Hair does not obscure the face, without requiring a specific style.
aliases: keeping your hair away from your face

allowedValues.label: Hair up
allowedValues.description: Hair is worn up, preserving the source's broader wording without assuming a specific tied-back style.

allowedValues.label: Hair down
allowedValues.description: Hair is worn down.

allowedValues.label: Natural hair
allowedValues.description: Hair is presented in the source-described natural state; this does not imply a natural hair color.

fields.label: Hair color
fields.description: A source form's generic hair-color field when the source does not say the color must be natural.

fields.label: Eye color
fields.description: A source form's generic eye-color field when the source does not say the color must be natural.

fields.label: Makeup level
fields.description: The visible level of makeup in an image.

allowedValues.label: No makeup
allowedValues.description: No visible makeup.

allowedValues.label: Minimal makeup
allowedValues.description: A minimal or natural-looking makeup presentation.

allowedValues.label: Styled makeup
allowedValues.description: Clearly styled or prominent makeup.

fields.label: Accessory type
fields.description: An accessory category explicitly addressed by a submission source.

allowedValues.label: Large accessories
allowedValues.description: Large or visually distracting accessories.

allowedValues.label: Jewelry
allowedValues.description: Jewelry of any size when a source addresses the category generally.

fields.label: Hair product used
fields.description: Whether hair product is visibly used or declared for the submitted image.

fields.label: Natural hair color
fields.description: The applicant's self-reported natural hair color.

fields.label: Natural eye color
fields.description: The applicant's self-reported natural eye color.

fields.label: Smile visible
fields.description: Whether the applicant is smiling in the image.

fields.label: Expression style
fields.description: A source-defined overall facial expression or posing direction that is not safely reducible to smile presence alone.

allowedValues.label: Neutral
allowedValues.description: A neutral facial expression without an inferred mood.

allowedValues.label: Natural and relaxed
allowedValues.description: A natural, relaxed presentation rather than an assumed formal pose.

fields.label: Clothing fit
fields.description: How closely clothing follows the applicant's body shape.

allowedValues.label: Form-fitted
allowedValues.description: Clothing is fitted enough for body shape to be visible.

allowedValues.label: Slim-fitting
allowedValues.description: Clothing has a slim fit.

allowedValues.label: Baggy
allowedValues.description: Loose clothing whose volume obscures or substantially changes the visible body outline.

fields.label: Clothing category
fields.description: A garment category explicitly required, permitted, or prohibited by a source.

allowedValues.label: Vest top
allowedValues.description: A vest or tank-style top.

allowedValues.label: Jeans
allowedValues.description: Jeans without an inferred fit.

allowedValues.label: Slim-fitting jeans
allowedValues.description: Jeans explicitly described as slim fitting.

allowedValues.label: Swimwear
allowedValues.description: Swimwear submitted as clothing in an image.

allowedValues.label: Underwear
allowedValues.description: Underwear or lingerie submitted as clothing in an image.

allowedValues.label: High heels
allowedValues.description: High-heeled footwear.

fields.label: Upper-body clothing state
fields.description: A source-defined state describing whether the upper body is clothed, without treating the state as a garment category.

allowedValues.label: Shirtless
allowedValues.description: No shirt or upper-body garment is worn.

fields.label: Clothing style
fields.description: A source-defined clothing presentation that cannot be reduced to fit or a garment category.

allowedValues.label: Favorite outfit
allowedValues.description: An applicant-selected favorite outfit used to show personal style.

allowedValues.label: Personal style
allowedValues.description: Clothing selected to communicate the applicant's personal style, without requiring one garment category.

fields.label: Background
fields.description: The visual complexity or source-defined character of the image background.

allowedValues.label: Plain
allowedValues.description: A plain, non-environmental background.

allowedValues.label: Uncluttered
allowedValues.description: A background clear from clutter without implying a plain wall or studio backdrop.

fields.label: Image style
fields.description: A source-defined overall presentation of an image that is not limited to its background, lighting, or alteration state.

allowedValues.label: Clean and simple
allowedValues.description: An overall clean and simple image presentation without implying a specific background.

fields.label: Lighting
fields.description: The source-defined lighting conditions for submission images.

allowedValues.label: Front-facing natural daylight
allowedValues.description: Natural daylight illuminates the applicant from the front.

allowedValues.label: Bright natural light
allowedValues.description: Bright natural light without a stricter directional claim.

allowedValues.label: Natural light
allowedValues.description: Natural rather than artificial or heavily styled light.

allowedValues.label: Well-lit
allowedValues.description: A space with sufficient light, without inferring that the light is natural, bright, or front-facing.

fields.label: Color mode
fields.description: Whether the submitted image is in color or monochrome.

allowedValues.label: Color
allowedValues.description: A color image rather than monochrome.

fields.label: Capture device
fields.description: The type of device explicitly permitted or requested for making a submission image.

allowedValues.label: Phone
allowedValues.description: A mobile phone camera.

fields.label: Body proportions visible
fields.description: Whether an image visibly shows the applicant's body proportions as requested by the source.

fields.label: Professional photography
fields.description: Whether the image was made as professional photography.

fields.label: Selfie
fields.description: Whether the submitted image is a selfie.

fields.label: Filter used
fields.description: Whether a visual filter was applied to the image.

fields.label: Effects used
fields.description: Whether visual effects were applied to the image.

fields.label: Retouching used
fields.description: Whether the image was retouched.

fields.label: File count
fields.description: The total number of image files submitted through the scoped channel.

fields.label: File size
fields.description: The size of one file or the package, normalized to bytes according to sourceValue.normalization.

fields.label: File MIME type
fields.description: The MIME type of an uploaded file when explicitly constrained.

fields.label: First name
fields.description: The applicant's first or given name.

fields.label: Full name
fields.description: The applicant's name when the source presents one combined field and does not expose separate given- and family-name controls.

fields.label: Nationality
fields.description: The applicant's source-form nationality value, preserved as a free string without inferring citizenship, residence, ethnicity, or work authorization.

fields.label: Last name
fields.description: The applicant's last or family name.

fields.label: Date of birth
fields.description: The applicant's date of birth.

fields.label: Age
fields.description: The applicant's age in completed years at evaluation time.

fields.label: Applicant track
fields.description: The source-defined application track, not an inferred statement about identity.

allowedValues.label: Women
allowedValues.description: The women or source-labelled female application track.

allowedValues.label: Men
allowedValues.description: The men or source-labelled male application track.

allowedValues.label: Curve
allowedValues.description: A source-labelled curve application track.

allowedValues.label: Non-binary
allowedValues.description: A source-labelled non-binary application track.

fields.label: Gender
fields.description: The gender category or audience named by the source; this preserves source language and is not an inferred statement about the applicant's identity.

allowedValues.label: Male
allowedValues.description: The source-labelled male category or audience.

allowedValues.label: Female
allowedValues.description: The source-labelled female category or audience.

allowedValues.label: Non-binary
allowedValues.description: The source-labelled non-binary category or audience.

allowedValues.label: Female identified
allowedValues.description: The source-labelled female-identified audience, preserved without inferring identity.

fields.label: Pronouns
fields.description: The applicant's self-reported pronouns.

fields.label: Current representation
fields.description: Whether or how the applicant is currently represented.

fields.label: Applicant story
fields.description: A narrative about the applicant, their background, or goals.

fields.label: Application message
fields.description: A free-text message included with the application.

fields.label: Applicant height
fields.description: Applicant height normalized to centimeters for eligibility evaluation.

fields.label: Destination market
fields.description: The office, city, or market selected to receive the scoped application; this is application routing, not the applicant's residence.

fields.label: Division interest
fields.description: A source-defined division or board that the applicant asks to be considered for.

fields.label: Scoped work authorization
fields.description: Whether the applicant confirms lawful status to live and work in the selected territory; the value is meaningful only within the route's destination-market scope.

fields.label: Route account password
fields.description: Presence of a password control used to create or access an account required by the submission route. Credential values must never be persisted in the Spec Registry.

fields.label: Route account password confirmation
fields.description: Presence of a password-confirmation control for the submission route. Credential values must never be persisted in the Spec Registry.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: The applicant's contact email address.

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: The applicant's contact phone number.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: The applicant's street or mailing address.

fields.label: City
fields.description: The applicant's city or local area.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: A source's combined free-text location field when it does not expose separate city, region, or country controls.

fields.label: Country
fields.description: The applicant's country.

fields.label: Postal code
fields.description: The applicant's ZIP or postal code.

fields.label: State or region
fields.description: The applicant's state, province, or first-level region.

fields.label: Preferred contact method
fields.description: The applicant's source-form selection for how the receiving organization should contact them.

fields.label: Instagram
fields.description: The applicant's Instagram account or URL.

fields.label: TikTok
fields.description: The applicant's TikTok account or URL.

fields.label: YouTube
fields.description: The applicant's YouTube account or URL.

fields.label: Facebook
fields.description: The applicant's Facebook account or URL.

fields.label: X / Twitter

fields.label: Twitch
fields.description: The applicant's Twitch account or URL.

fields.label: Social media account
fields.description: A source form's generic social-media account field when it is not limited to one named platform.

fields.label: Height field
fields.description: A source form's height field before unit-specific normalization.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: The applicant's self-reported weight in the source form's unit.

fields.description: The applicant's self-reported clothing size in the source form's system.

fields.label: Shoe size

fields.label: Cup size
fields.description: The applicant's self-reported cup size.

fields.label: Guardian name
fields.description: The parent or legal guardian's name.

fields.label: Guardian title
fields.description: The source-defined honorific selected for the parent or guardian; it is preserved without inferring gender or marital status.

allowedValues.description: The source-labelled Ms title.

allowedValues.description: The source-labelled guardian relationship.
